Name: SaveSDV - Stardew Valley Save Editor
Author: FedotovDev
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
Simple Stardew Valley save editor written in Python and Lua. Currently it can only rename your character, rename your farm or edit money.

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]This is not a mod, so you just install it with the Setup (SaveSDV-Setup.exe) or unpack the ZIP file (SaveSDV-Portable.zip) in any location and run SaveSDV.exe.[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
You need Windows 8.1 or higher and the Stardew Valley game. I don't know if this app works with Wine, I didn't test it, so if someone tests it on Wine - please tell me in the posts.
